data.narrative:
Kreios Space is a Seed-stage space and aerospace company founded by Adrián Senar, Jan Matarό, Francisco Boira, Adria Barceló, Max Amer, and Francisco Bosch. The company has raised €8M to date. The Space & Aerospace sector comprises 6 public companies (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, and Sierra Space.

Only the Stage-Progression method is applicable to Kreios. Using total capital raised of €8M as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for Seed-to-Series A progression, this method implies a valuation of €20M. Peer-Median analysis cannot be applied—while 14 same-sector private peers exist, only one operates at the same stage, falling short of the three-comparable minimum required for statistical relevance. Public-Comp Anchoring is likewise inapplicable; the public Space & Aerospace median trades at 24.4x P/S across five tickers, but Kreios's revenue remains undisclosed, precluding this calculation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of €17M–€23M, centered on €20M. The primary uncertainty stems from limited methodological coverage: only one quantitative anchor is available. Subsequent rounds introducing revenue visibility or additional same-stage comparable data would meaningfully refine this range.
